content.journey: J02 — Onboarding e Criação da Fazenda

baseline.head: 6d63d8b597b18b353863f655662d82b557352061
baseline.confirmation: Read-only git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main; git diff main..HEAD empty for src, supabase, package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.

scenario_count.unit: 17 operational checks; desktop/mobile variants grouped by behavior; technical authentication fixture excluded

scenarios.name: Descoberta sem fazenda
scenarios.observed: Zero farms; two Criar nova fazenda actions visible; existing identity retained

scenarios.name: Campos obrigatórios
scenarios.observed: Empty submission rejected with Nome e obrigatorio on desktop and mobile

scenarios.name: Área negativa e recuperação
scenarios.observed: -10 rejected remotely; technical English constraint error shown; form remains editable; corrected input later succeeds

scenarios.name: Interrupção antes de enviar e retorno
scenarios.observed: Filled name/100ha/MG/Corte then browser back+forward; inputs reset without warning; no farm created by interruption

scenarios.name: Campos, máscara, unidades e layout
scenarios.observed: Area labeled ha, numeric step 0.01; alphabetic CEP removed; only name required; long form uses vertical scroll on mobile

scenarios.name: Criação válida
scenarios.observed: Submitted via mobile UI; Criando fazenda... observed; RPC returned 200 and farm ID; proceeded to onboarding

scenarios.name: Sucesso e contexto inicial
scenarios.observed: Fazenda Horizonte active; owner; onboarding 1/6 and next step Pastos; farm step simultaneously completed and location unrevised

scenarios.name: Disponibilidade do perfil ciclo completo
scenarios.observed: No explicit lifecycle production-cycle category in create/edit/settings inspected; persisted Corte only

scenarios.name: Home e próximos passos
scenarios.observed: Home active farm correct; operational empty states; first steps exist in collapsed section below daily panels; links include animal/lot/pasture/registration

scenarios.name: Animais vazio
scenarios.observed: Opened desktop and mobile; zero animals and Novo animal/Importar; empty message suggests filters rather than first registration

scenarios.name: Lotes vazio
scenarios.observed: Opened desktop and mobile; zero lots, explanatory empty state and Criar primeiro lote; no registration executed

scenarios.name: Pastos vazio
scenarios.observed: Opened desktop and mobile; zero pastures, explanatory empty state and Cadastrar primeiro pasto; no registration executed

scenarios.name: Atalho Registrar
scenarios.observed: Opened desktop Registrar and mobile Manejo; context wizard displayed; no operation advanced or saved

scenarios.name: Recarga
scenarios.observed: Home reload retained active farm and existing account

scenarios.name: Reabertura da aplicação
scenarios.observed: New tab in persistent Chromium opened root and reached Home with same identity/farm; previous app tab then closed; browser process not restarted

scenarios.name: Persistência e ausência de duplicidade
scenarios.observed: Read-only DB and edit UI confirm exactly one Horizonte, one original-user membership owner, active farm saved, MG/100ha/Corte, zero animals/lots/pastures/events

findings.preconditions: Existing authenticated J01 user with zero farms
findings.expected: Reject invalid area beside field with understandable Portuguese message; persist no farm
findings.observed: Request reaches create_fazenda; DB rejects with new row for relation fazendas violates check constraint fazendas_area_total_ha_check, shown raw in UI. No farm created.
findings.cause: CriarFazenda.tsx registers area with valueAsNumber only, without positive-value validation; createError.message is thrown and displayed directly.
findings.impact: User receives database internals rather than actionable area correction
findings.recommendation: Validate positive area when provided; map constraint/backend failures into field guidance; preserve database constraint and contract.

findings.preconditions: Farm MG/Corte created with optional municipality left blank
steps: Create farm with requested available fields
findings.expected: Completion badge and success criteria agree with current location state
findings.observed: Step says OK/Etapa concluida and contributes 1/6 while stating Localizacao nao revisada and requiring Nome e localizacao revisados.
findings.cause: OnboardingInicial.tsx:124 completes with tipo_producao OR municipio OR estado; location label at lines 110-113 requires municipio AND estado.
findings.impact: First-time user is told a step is complete while same screen says required review is missing
findings.recommendation: Align completion rule, displayed location and stated criteria; decide explicitly whether state alone suffices, without silently making optional fields mandatory.

steps: Inspect settings and edit without saving changes
findings.expected: Represent requested ciclo completo if product supports it
findings.observed: Available production taxonomy is Corte/Leite/Mista; no explicit ciclo completo selection found in inspected farm configuration.
findings.impact: Corte was persisted; full-cycle profile criterion is not demonstrated
findings.recommendation: Clarify whether ciclo completo is a supported farm attribute before proposing data-contract changes; do not equate Mista or Corte with explicit full cycle.

steps: Fill name, area, state and production
findings.expected: Help user anticipate or recover discarded input
findings.observed: Inputs reset without warning or recoverable draft.
findings.recommendation: Consider unsaved-change warning or temporary draft; never automatically submit or duplicate farm.

findings.preconditions: First-time user without knowledge of internal terms
steps: Expand Acompanhamento do rebanho e primeiros passos
findings.expected: Required information and next action easy to discover
findings.observed: Provisionamento terminology; required/optional fields not marked; Home first steps below operational panels and collapsed by default.
findings.impact: Extra scanning and failed submission to discover mandatory fields; first-action guidance competes with empty daily metrics
findings.recommendation: Mark required/optional fields, use Criar fazenda wording, and surface first steps prominently while farm is empty.

findings.expected: Explain genuinely empty farm and how to start
findings.observed: Nenhum animal ativo neste recorte suggests filters; creation action exists separately.
findings.impact: May suggest hidden animals instead of an empty new herd
findings.recommendation: When entire farm has no animals, present a first-registration state; retain filter-empty message for existing herds.

limitations: Ciclo completo not represented explicitly in inspected configuration; Corte persisted and not treated as equivalent.
No full browser-process restart, device hardware or virtual keyboard; reopening used a new tab in same persistent profile.
No induced network interruption after server commit, concurrent farm creation, retry/replay or offline farm creation; no claim of universal duplicate prevention.
CEP alphabetic sanitization observed, but valid numeric CEP and its persistence were not certified.
No correction, J01 repetition, J03 execution, global suite, lint/build, migration execution or canonical-document update.
